title: 'अकथ्य' कथामा क्षण, जाति र पर्यावरण {Moment, Caste and Environment in 'Akathya' Story}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा ऋषिराज बरालको कथासङ्ग्रह बर्की नं. १३९९९ मा सङ्कलित ‘अकथ्य’ कथामा क्षण, जाति र पर्यावरणकोअध्ययन गरिएको छ । क्षण, जाति र पर्यावरण अध्ययनको आधार हिप्पोलाइट तेनको मान्यतालाई बनाइएको छ । उनका अनुसार प्रजाति, परिवेश र क्षणबाट एउटा भौतिक आधारको निर्माण र त्यस युगको रचना पाइन्छ । यही कुरालाई आधार मानेर समाजशास्त्रीय चिन्तन अन्तर्गत तेनद्वारा प्रतिपादित साहित्यलाई अध्ययन गर्ने आधारमध्ये क्षण, जाति र पर्यावरणमा अध्ययन केन्द्रित रहेको छ । प्रस्तुत कथामा जनयुद्धको समयमा रोल्पाका सहिद परिवारकी महिला धनसरा पुन गरिबी र अभावमा बाँचेकी छन् । त्यही समाजको अब्बरे शोषक र सामन्तवादी चरित्र बोकेको पात्र हो यही कथावस्तुभित्र रहेर क्षण, जाति र पर्यावरण आदिको आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । आर्थिक अवस्थाले निर्माण गरेको संरचना र ग्रामीण भेगमा अन्याय र अत्याचारले पारेको प्रभावको खोजी गरी परिवर्तको अपेक्षा कायम गरिएकोछ ।
american_english: In this article, a study of moment, race, and environment is conducted on the story 'Akathya,' collected in Rishiraj Baral's short story collection Barki No. 13999. Hippolyte Taine's theory has been made the foundation for studying moment, race, and environment. According to him, the creation of a material basis and the literary production of that era are derived from race, milieu, and moment. Taking this premise as the basis, the study focuses on moment, race, and environment among the foundations formulated by Taine within sociological thought for the study of literature. In the presented story, during the period of the People's War, Dhansara Pun, a woman from a martyr's family in Rolpa, lives in poverty and scarcity. Abbare is a character embodying the exploitative and feudal nature of that very society; within this plotline, an analysis has been carried out on the basis of moment, race, environment, and so forth. Investigating the structure built by economic conditions and the impact exerted by injustice and oppression in rural regions, an expectation of change is maintained.

informal_english: This article takes a look at moment, race and environment in the short story 'Akathya', which is part of Rishiraj Baral's collection Barki No. 13999. It leans on Hippolyte Taine’s ideas as the grounding for digging into moment, race and environment. As far as he saw it, race, milieu and moment build up the material groundwork and the actual writing of an era. With that in mind, the study zooms right in on moment, race and environment out of the literary-sociology tools Taine laid out. In the story itself, Dhansara Pun, a woman from a martyr’s family up in Rolpa during the People’s War, is scraping by in poverty and hardship. Abbare is the local exploiter with pure feudal habits; working right inside this plot, the analysis unpacks things through moment, race and environment. By chasing up how economic setups work and what injustice and brutality do to rural life, it holds onto hope for real change.
translator_notes: The critical terminology reflects Hippolyte Taine's classic sociological triad 'race, milieu et moment' (Nepali: प्रजाति/जाति, परिवेश/पर्यावरण, क्षण). The source sentence boundary in the Abbare clause is preserved.
